The Complete Season Five |publisher=[[Warner Bros.|Warner Home Video]] |release date=*[[October 15]], [[2013]] {{C|US}}{{SW|url=news/swce-2013-star-wars-the-clone-wars-the-complete-season-five-and-seasons-1-5-box-sets-coming-this-fall|text=SWCE 2013: ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Five'' and Seasons 1-5 Box Sets Coming This Fall|nolive=1}} *[[October 14]], 2013 {{C|UK}}{{Amazon|domain=co.uk|url=Star-Wars-Clone-Season-DVD/dp/B00APGRM78|text=Star Wars Clone Wars - Season 5 (DVD)}} |runtime=447 minutes |upc= |isbn= |media type=*Blu-ray disc *DVD |resolution=*1080p (Blu-ray disc) *480p (DVD) |ratio=2.35:1 |audio=English *DTS-HD Master Audio 5.1 |subtitles=English }} '''''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Five''' is a two-disc Blu-ray or three-disc DVD set of the [[2012]]–[[2013]] [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|fifth season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. It was released by [[Warner Bros.|Warner Home Video]] on [[October 15]], 2013. ==Contents== The discs include all 20 episodes of [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|Season Five]], with Director's Cuts of "[[Eminence (episode)|Eminence]]" and "[[Shades of Reason]]." Episodes are in chronological order, with "[[Revival (episode)|Revival]]" placed between "[[Point of No Return (The Clone Wars)|Point of No Return]]" and "Eminence." As with previous seasons, there is a "Jedi Temple Archives" feature exclusive to the Blu-ray set. There are also three [[Easter egg (virtual)|Easter eggs]]: artwork by [[Dave Filoni]], [[Celebration VI]] Chalk Art, and a timeline of [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]: "Ahsoka Tano: A Jedi's Journey." ==Media== ===Editions=== *UPC 883929261680; [[October 15]], [[2013]]; [[Warner Bros.|Warner Home Video]]; US Blu-ray disc{{BN|url=w/dvd-star-wars-the-clone-wars-season-5/26459117|text=Star Wars: the Clone Wars - Season 5}} {{C|Blu-ray}} *UPC 883929261703; October 15, 2013; Warner Home Video; US DVD{{BN|url=w/dvd-star-wars-the-clone-wars-season-5/26459118|text=Star Wars: the Clone Wars - Season 5}} {{C|DVD}} ===Cover gallery=== File:TCWS5-Bluray.jpg|Blu-ray disc File:TCWS5-DVD.jpg|DVD ==Sources== *{{SW|url=news/swce-2013-star-wars-the-clone-wars-the-complete-season-five-and-seasons-1-5-box-sets-coming-this-fall|text=SWCE 2013: ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Five'' and Seasons 1-5 Box Sets Coming This Fall|nolive=1}} *{{InsiderCite|144|Launchpad|Launch Pad}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{TheCloneWarsEpisodes}} {{Interlang |ka=ვარსკვლავური ომები: კლონების ომები: სრული მეხუთე სეზონი }} [[Category:Star Wars: The Clone Wars home video releases]]
